requirement:
When the backend and model support prompt caching, every provider request MUST
place one cache checkpoint after the system prompt of
{cite}`requirements.authoring.prompt_parts` and another at the end of its last
message, so each request reuses the tool definitions and system prompt that
earlier assessments of its kind sent, and the conversation its own earlier
requests sent. Cache checkpoints MUST NOT change the content of a request.
rationale:
The requirement is satisfied by the inspected implementation and its marked tests.

The obligations of `requirements.authoring.cache_checkpoints` are:

1. When checkpoint caching is supported, every request places a checkpoint after the system prompt described by `requirements.authoring.prompt_parts`.
2. Under the same condition, every request places another checkpoint at the end of its last message. These placements provide the reusable tool/system prefix and prior-conversation prefix described in the requirement.
3. Adding checkpoints must not change request content.

**Implementation.** `src/authoring/providers.rs#impl[RigProvider]/fn[connect]` selects checkpoint support through `src/authoring/providers.rs#fn[bedrock_caches]`. That helper recognizes Claude and Nova through `vendor/habeas-rig/src/completion.rs#impl[Family]/fn[of]`. The connection code distinguishes OpenAI-managed caching and Ollama's lack of checkpoint support from Bedrock checkpoint caching.

`src/authoring/providers.rs#impl[RigProvider/CompletionProvider]/fn[complete]` applies `src/authoring/providers.rs#fn[place_cache_checkpoints]` before each supported request is sent. The helper sets the short cache-retention option without editing the messages or tools. The reachable Bedrock encoder, `vendor/habeas-rig/src/completion.rs#impl[Converse/Wire]/fn[encode]`, calls the request builder. In `vendor/habeas-rig/src/request.rs#fn[base]`, the builder appends a separate checkpoint block after the leading system prompt and another to the last message's content. Both additions leave the existing content intact; the final checkpoint is also placed following reasoning turns. Thus the cited prompt-parts requirement is applied to the system prompt in this case without needing to reassess prompt construction itself.

**Tests.** `src/authoring/providers.rs#mod[tests]/fn[cache_checkpoints_are_requested_for_caching_models]` checks supported Claude and Nova identifiers, unsupported identifiers, the cache option, and serialized equality apart from that option. It also exercises a request containing reasoning.

`tests/authoring_cli.rs#fn[claude_requests_carry_cache_checkpoints_and_record_cache_usage]` verifies both required placements on each of two actual provider request bodies, asserts exactly two checkpoints, and checks the continuation request containing reasoning. Its reachable helper `tests/authoring_cli.rs#fn[bedrock_run]` drives an assessment through a tool-read turn and submission. The test compares cached request bodies, after removing checkpoints, against uncached request bodies, directly verifying the unchanged-content obligation for both initial and continuation requests. Both tests carry the subject's `{test}` reference.

No gap was found.
